2607.13330.title: Efficient Text-to-Audio Generation via Pruning
2607.13330.paper_summary: Diffusion-based text-to-audio generative models such as AudioLDM achieve high perceptual quality and strong semantic consistency; however, their practical deployment is hindered by the substantial computational cost of the U-Net denoising backbone. In this work, we apply model pruning to improve the computational efficiency of AudioLDM, a U-Net-based text-conditioned audio latent diffusion model. We analyse parameter redundancy across U-Net convolutional blocks and evaluate a filter-pruning strategy. Pruning is guided by norm-based criteria and followed by lightweight finetuning to recover performance losses. Experimental results demonstrate that up to 83% of the parameters and 39% of the multiply-accumulate operations of U-Net have been reduced while maintaining, and in some cases improving, generation quality compared to the baseline unpruned network. We find that pruning affects AudioLDM's ability to generate certain sound events including safety-critical sounds such as gunshots, sirens, and explosions, as well as mechanical sounds such as drills and sewing machines, and other sounds such as sprays and tick-tocks, which are mostly recovered by lightweight finetuning of the pruned model.
2607.13330.paper_summary_zh: 擴散基礎的文本到音頻生成模型，如 AudioLDM，實現了高感知質量和強語義一致性；然而，它們的實際部署受到 U-Net 去噪骨幹的高計算成本的阻礙。在這項工作中，我們應用模型修剪來提高 AudioLDM 的計算效率，這是一種基於 U-Net 的文本條件音頻潛在擴散模型。我們分析了 U-Net 卷積塊中的參數冗餘，並評估了過濾器修剪策略。修剪是根據基於範數的標準進行的，隨後進行輕量級微調以恢復性能損失。實驗結果表明，在保持生成質量的同時，最多減少了 U-Net 的 83% 參數和 39% 的乘加運算，並在某些情況下改善了生成質量，與基線未修剪網絡相比。我們發現，修剪影響了 AudioLDM 生成某些聲音事件的能力，包括安全關鍵聲音，如槍聲、警報聲和爆炸聲，以及機械聲音，如電鑽和縫紉機，還有其他聲音，如噴霧聲和滴答聲，這些聲音大多通過對修剪模型進行輕量級微調來恢復。
